Author: Yousv
Description:
[center][color=#8e7cc3][size=6][b]Scroll Empty Slots[/b][/size][/color][/center]
[center][size=4]Scroll to empty hotbar slots with the mouse wheel or controller.[/size]
[line]
[/center]
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54296/54296-1792676284-1528635756.png[/img][/center]

[center][b][color=#8e7cc3][size=6]Features[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Hotbar Scrolling[/b][/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Mouse wheel scrolls to empty hotbar slots.[/*]
[*]Controller scrolls to empty hotbar slots.[/*]
[/list][b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]Configuration[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Enable for Mouse Wheel[/b] - Scroll to empty hotbar slots with the mouse wheel.[/*]
[*][b]Enable for Controller[/b] - Scroll to empty hotbar slots with the controller (LT/RT).[/*]
[/list][line]
[center][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/center]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0.0+[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6+[/*]
[/list]
Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration. Without it, edit the config.json file directly.
[line]
[center][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/center]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract the mod folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][line]
